caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The object is a curved, elongated shape that resembles a piece of carved wood or bone. Its color palette includes shades of brown, beige, and yellow with some darker and lighter areas to suggest depth and shadow. The surface of the object is decorated with carved, wavy patterns, including swirls and elongated leaf-like motifs that run along its length. There are also areas with darker shading, particularly following the contours of the carved motifs, which give the object a sense of three-dimensionality. The edges of the object are irregular, and its overall form tapers to a point on the right side while being broader and flat on the left. There are a few small, dark spots along the object's lower edge, possibly indicating holes or notches. The composition is simple, with the single object isolated against the uncluttered background.
title: Stern Piece
